stop_expansion_rule: Once cutoff reached: no new searches/downloads/families/authored tasks;only prepare/check/freeze/deliver current work. If deadline already passed,report actual current state and stop automation without further research.
priority_order: grade-by-family review inventory and one complete representative per source-observed cell
complete missing authored task families using already reviewed full ordinary-source patterns
review UI with complete material/responses/options/media and hidden answer/rubric
targeted source repair only when needed for current representative correctness
final necessary checks/focused commits/storage increment/review page delivery and unresolved report
completion_unit: one complete major task group per grade and observed task family;not one subquestion
unknown_cells: show evidence insufficient,not this grade lacks type;do not synthesize missing grade/type combinations
listening: separate declared gap unless complete audio/script/student input/key package verified;do not label a text prompt as complete listening
quality_evidence: author review/local checks only;independent teacher/student/commercial/production remain unverified
finish_action: deliver consolidated report and review page,delete automation,wait for user quality review
next_actions: Wait for user review of complete grade/family author tasks;no automatic new research
completion_scope: limited authored quality review delivery with disclosed gaps;not original full benchmark acceptance or all source modes
